title: A record ID that does not match the ID pattern is refused by the registry, naming the ID
accepts: TL-V2B, TL-INT02
refuses: TL-v01, tl-V01, 1TL-V01, TL--V01, TL-V01-, an ID with a space, TL_V01

title: An empty or blank title is refused, and a missing one is required
accepts: A title with spaces around it
refuses: An empty title, one of only spaces, and none

title: An empty or blank statement is refused, and a missing one is required
accepts: The fixture's statements
refuses: An empty statement, one of only spaces, and none

title: Every rule and requirement in Lathe's own spec states its rule with MUST, SHOULD or MAY under a short title
accepts: Every statement of Lathe's own constraints, invariants, UC, view and API requirements, pattern rules and standard rules, each with MUST, SHOULD or MAY, under a title of at most 15 words
refuses: Expects every Lathe requirement and domain rule statement to use MUST, SHOULD or MAY, under a title of at most 15 words.

title: A position that is not a whole number from 1 is refused
An empty or blank flow step's path is refused
accepts: tool on loan
refuses: An empty path and one of only spaces

title: An identifier that is not lower-case letters, digits and underscores from a letter is refused
accepts: record_2
refuses: Record, record-id, 1record, _record, a name with a space

title: A subdomain type other than core, supporting or generic is refused
accepts: core, supporting, generic
refuses: Core

title: An entity's role other than root or child, or none, is refused
accepts: root, child
refuses: leaf, and no role

title: A basic type other than the seven is refused
accepts: Each of the seven basic types
refuses: integer, boolean

title: A table storage other than the six is refused
accepts: table, view, materialized view, browser storage, file, in memory
refuses: index

title: A key type other than primary, unique, foreign or index is refused
accepts: primary, unique, foreign, index
refuses: check

title: An endpoint's method that is not an HTTP method is refused
accepts: Each of the seven methods
refuses: post, TRACE

title: An event type's delivery other than in process or outbox is refused
accepts: in process, outbox
refuses: queue

title: A test's level other than the five is refused
accepts: Each of the five levels
refuses: e2e-ui, manual, Browser

title: A test's state other than automated, manual or not automated yet is refused
accepts: automated, manual, not automated yet
refuses: skipped, Automated

title: refuses an automated test with no file
accepts: The fixture's automated invariant test, which names its file
refuses: The same test with its file left out, refused by a `check` on `invariant_test`

title: Only a manual test gives a manual reason
accepts: The fixture's manual integration test with its reason, and its automated invariant test with none
refuses: The manual integration test with no reason, and the automated invariant test with the reason `Why not.`, each refused by a `check` on its table

title: A product kind field's type other than text, integer, boolean or date is refused
accepts: text, integer, boolean, date
refuses: decimal, whole number

title: A stage other than the six is refused
accepts: Each of the six stages, and none
refuses: build, Test plan

title: A relation's role other than design or proof is refused, and none is allowed
accepts: design, proof, and none
refuses: evidence

title: Group names equal trimmed and in any letter case are one group; others are not
accepts: Validation, "  validation " and VALIDATION as one group
refuses: Validations and Paging as that group

title: A check name is lower-case words joined by hyphens
accepts: house-rule
refuses: Too_Many, too--many, -too-many, too many, each refused by a `check` on `check` naming `data/check.jsonl`

title: A check severity is error, warning or error_or_warning
accepts: error, warning
refuses: info, refused as not one of error, warning, error_or_warning

title: A children limit is a whole number of at least 1
refuses: 0, refused by a `check` on `product_setting`; "two" and 2.5, refused as not a whole number

title: Mod is Cmd on macOS and Ctrl elsewhere
accepts: Mod+Shift+P (kept as Shift+Meta+P on macOS and Ctrl+Shift+P elsewhere), key events read as Meta+P, Alt+Meta+B, Ctrl+Shift+-, Shift+F8, ? and +, and the sequence G C
refuses: Ctrl+P on macOS, a binding whose command has no handler right now, and Alt+ArrowLeft, a browser key: none matches a command

title: Every command has a title, and no binding clashes or takes a browser key
accepts: Every command's default keys, on macOS and elsewhere, none of which matches a reserved browser key once normalized
refuses: Checks every row of the keymap for an id, title and group, finds no duplicate binding on either platform and no reserved key, shows that the duplicate check catches a clash and a sequence prefix, and checks the VS Code defaults.

title: A theme with an unknown token or a value of the wrong kind is refused on import
accepts: The token values of a built-in theme's file, which parses back unchanged
refuses: Round-trips a theme file, refuses another version or format, unknown fields, unknown tokens and values that reach past the token, fills a partial file from Lathe, and imports a file on the Appearance page as a theme of one's own.

title: A theme exports as a versioned lathe-theme file, and a file with any other field is refused
accepts: A built-in theme's file, with exactly `format` lathe-theme, `version` 1, `name`, `light`, `dark` and `tokens`, which parses back unchanged
refuses: Round-trips a theme file, refuses another version or format, unknown fields, unknown tokens and values that reach past the token, fills a partial file from Lathe, and imports a file on the Appearance page as a theme of one's own.

title: The main process applies only valid theme colors to a window's chrome
accepts: { background: '#0a0f12', foreground: '#eee' }, applied as #0A0F12 and #EEEEEE, and { background: '#DDE3E6', foreground: '#1D2830' }
refuses: Expects its background set, and off a Mac its overlay; then sends names, alpha colors, `rgb()`, injected text, numbers, missing and extra keys, and expects each refused with nothing changed.

title: Each record, product, domain and group has one address, and app pages are lowercase words
accepts: A record at its bare ID (`/P-D-UC01`), a product and a domain at theirs (`/P-D`), and a group at its parent's ID and its place in the tree (`/P-D/define/use-cases`).
refuses: Any second address for the same record or group: `addressOf` gives each one address, and a path reads back as the record or group it names.

title: An address names its stage only in its stage query, so switching stages never changes the path
accepts: `?stage=erd` after a record's path, opening that record on the ERD stage with the path unchanged.
refuses: A stage in the path: `withStage` adds it only as the query.

title: A stage is one of graph, erd and trace
accepts: `graph`, `erd` and `trace`, and `?stage=erd` in a query.
refuses: `wiki`, `model`, `split`, `nonsense`, an empty value and none (read as no stage), `?stage=wiki`, and the old `?view=` query, which names no stage.

title: Depth is 1 to 3, and the layout is one of three
accepts: Depths 1, 2 and 3 in each of the tree, nested and voronoi layouts.
refuses: A depth of 0, 4, 2.5 or -1 (read as 1), and a layout of grid (the settings dropped for the defaults).

title: An entities limit below 1, or one that is not a whole number, is refused
refuses: 0 by the table's check, and 2.5 as a value of the wrong type.
